null: labels shuffled within stratum (stratified permutation), every probe refit
borderline_note: DISQUALIFIED, but the worst cell's family-adjusted p (0.0383) is within a factor of two of alpha (0.05). Treat this as 'close to the line at this n and this family size', not as settled. More items, or a different family size, could flip it either way.
headline: worst cell A* = 0.565 in length/_all (n=561), family-adjusted p = 0.0383 over 6 cells

power.mde_basis: one planted spelling/length artifact (a character appended to a fraction of the label-1 items) in a single stratum, 4 seeds; a wider family, a smaller cell or an artifact of another shape lowers power below this
power.note_on_comparison: A* depends on n. Do not rank this battery against one of a different size: cities.csv is DISQUALIFIED at n=1496 and PASSES 5 of 5 subsamples at n=354.
power.reading: DISQUALIFIED at n=561, which is above the measured detection threshold (~60% coverage) — the artifact is large enough to see at this size.

scope: SCOPE: this measures how much of the label signal is recoverable from SURFACE FORM alone by six model-free probes, two-sided, refit inside every permutation (labels shuffled within stratum) and family-wise corrected across all cells (Westfall-Young min-p). A PASS does NOT certify the benchmark is good: it cannot see circularity (labels drawn from the same store the system under test retrieves from), contamination, or mislabelling. It scores no model.
